room.title: Sales and Account Managers
room.description: How a seller runs quarter end and a renewal book on one surface — the pipeline, the forecast maths, the close plan and the accounts at risk all in view at once, so the forecast call is about decisions, not digging.

desks.title: Quarter-end forecast — $228k to close in 20 days
desks.description: New-business pipeline at quarter end: what's won, what's committed, the $38k gap that commit doesn't cover, and the close plan for the biggest deal.
desks.brief:
## Quarter-end forecast — new business

**Quota** $640,000 new ARR · **Closed won** $412,000 across three deals
**Quarter ends** @+20d · **Forecast call with Renata** @+1d
**Selling** rostering and timesheets to multi-site operators

### The maths
Won $412,000 + commit $190,000 = **$602,000, which is $38,000 short of quota**. One best-case deal has to land as well. Copperleaf Cafés ($46,000) is the likelier: their trial ends @+5d and the site managers are using it daily. Sunfield Pharmacies ($84,000) is bigger, but it needs their CFO, who hasn't met us yet.

### Commit, and why
- **Fernleigh Early Learning — $118,000.** Verbal yes from Mai, the operations director. Procurement needs our security pack and a signed close plan
- **Alder Health — $72,000.** Legal redlines back @+2d; the only open point is the liability cap

### What I won't do
Discount to pull Sunfield forward. If it slips to next quarter, it slips at full price.

callout.title: Commit leaves us $38k short
callout.body: One best-case deal has to close. Copperleaf's trial readout @+5d decides it: if usage holds above 80% of rostered staff, ask for the signature on that call.

rows.next: Lost to incumbent; revisit at their renewal

children.label: Ask for the signature on the call
No discounts to pull deals forward

blocks.h3: Mutual close plan — Fernleigh Early Learning

blocks.p: Agreed with Mai, the operations director, so both sides can see what has to happen before signature. 22 centres, $118,000 ARR, three-year term.

ol: @+1d — We send the security pack and data-hosting statement
@+3d — Fernleigh IT returns the security questionnaire
@+5d — Pricing and terms confirmed in writing
@+11d — Contract signed by Ellis, the CEO
@+18d — Kick-off; first four centres live within 30 days

blocks.p: The procurement panel only meets fortnightly. If the questionnaire isn't back by @+3d, the review moves past quarter end. **Tripwire:** not in by @+4d, I tell Renata and move the deal to best case.

ul: Procurement panel — finance, IT and two centre directors

notes.title: Forecast call prep — what Renata will ask
notes.body:
- Why is Fernleigh commit, not best case? A verbal yes, a close plan they've agreed, procurement dates in writing
- What's my call? $648,000 — won, commit and Copperleaf. That's 101% of quota
- What's the downside? If both commits slip we finish at $412k — 64% of quota
- What's the upside? Copperleaf and Sunfield, $130k of best case, together take us to $732k
- Anything I need from her? An exec sponsor for Sunfield's CFO
- Larch Retail went to the incumbent on price; they renew in 18 months

stickies.title: Today
stickies.body:
1. Security pack to Fernleigh
2. Check Copperleaf trial usage
3. Prep the forecast call

stickies.title: Rule
stickies.body: No discount to pull a deal forward. It just moves the problem.

desks.title: Renewals, next 90 days — 3 enterprise accounts at risk
desks.description: An account manager's renewal book: $1.01m up for renewal, three big accounts at risk, and the save plan for the largest — where a new COO is reviewing every tool.
desks.brief:
## Renewal book — next 90 days

**Book** 10 accounts · **$1,009,000 ARR** up for renewal
**At risk** $408,000 across three accounts · **Watch** $134,000 · **Healthy** $467,000
**Target** 95% gross retention, with Linden's expansion on top

### The three at risk
- **Corran Health — $186,000.** Champion left; the new COO is reviewing every tool; 41% of seats active
- **Banksia Facilities — $128,000.** Budget cut; they've asked for 30% fewer seats. A right-sized renewal beats losing them
- **Bellmere Hospitality — $94,000.** The payroll integration broke twice last quarter. Renews @+17d, the soonest of the three

### What 95% means here
95% of $1,009,000 is $958,550, so the book can lose at most $50,450. Banksia's seat cut alone costs $38,400, which leaves $12,050 of headroom. **Corran and Bellmere both have to renew in full.**

### This week
Corran value review drafted, Bellmere's fix confirmed in writing by support, Banksia's offer approved by Renata.

callout.title: Corran Health: 41% of seats active
callout.body: The champion who bought us has left, and the new COO, Farah, is reviewing every tool over $100k a year. She gets a value review by site before @+10d — usage, rostering hours saved, payroll corrections avoided. Not a discount.

rows.plan: Value review for the new COO

children.label: Get the number from their payroll lead

blocks.p: 11 sites, 640 seats, $186,000 ARR, renews @+24d. A customer for three years.

Jonah, the operations lead who bought the platform, left mid-year. The new COO, Farah, has started a review of every tool over $100,000 a year. Seats active have fallen from 68% to 41% since Jonah left, mostly at the five sites that never finished rollout.

ol: Value review by site: usage, rostering hours saved, payroll corrections avoided
Finish rollout at the five low-use sites — a 30-day plan, at our cost
Two site managers tell Farah, in their words, what they'd lose
Renata joins as exec sponsor for the COO meeting

blocks.p: Renew all 11 sites at the current price. If Farah wants fewer seats, right-size to active use — but no discount on the per-seat price.

notes.title: Banksia — the right-size maths
notes.body:
They asked for 30% fewer seats. Usage says 42% of seats sit idle, so the ask is fair.

- Current: $128,000
- 30% fewer seats: $89,600 kept, $38,400 lost
- Losing them entirely: $128,000 lost

Offer the cut with a two-year term at today's price. Renata has to approve the term. Then spend the time saved on Corran.

stickies.title: This week
stickies.body:
1. Corran value review
2. Bellmere fix in writing
3. Banksia offer to Renata

stickies.title: Bellmere
stickies.body: Tell them about the integration fix before they ask. Renews @+17d.
